Search budget (20) exhausted.

verification.notes: 8 WebSearch calls used. XP9 (2006-2008): 3750/1695/1530/2460 and 272 l confirmed (carsales, vehiclesizes 272-275 l); 737 l folded not independently found (vehiclesizes gives roof-high 1086-1183 l), but no contradicting manufacturer figure. XP9 facelift: 3785/1695/1530/2460 confirmed (cars-data.com, fastcarcheck.uk); trunk sources disagree (fastcarcheck 272 l, cars-data 313 l), no manufacturer source contradicting ADAC 275 l. XP13 2011: 3885/1695/1510/2510 and 286 l confirmed (carsales AU). Folded value for pre-facelift remains unverified from manufacturer; UK reviews (carbuyer.co.uk, cinch.co.uk) give 768 l seats folded for the 2011-2020 generation as a whole, while carbuyer hybrid review and drivingelectric.com give 786 l - not strong enough to fill the null. XP13 2014 facelift: 3950/1695/1510 and 286 l confirmed (autobild.de Fahrbericht Yaris Hybrid 2014); 768 l not independently tied to 2014 (autobild generation range 206-768 l). XP13 2017 facelift: 3945/1695/1510 and 286 l confirmed (autotijd.be, carsales); 768 l max confirmed (vehiclesizes.com, Yaris III facelift 2017). Year ranges consistent with sources. No important missing German-market variants identified (no AWD/PHEV/BEV in these generations; GRMN and Hybrid already present).
